description: Targeted mutation audit; this is not a whole-project mutation score.
notes: Reports are preserved from the actual runs. The early baseline runner did not record source/snapshot hashes or byte offsets.
The final runner records byte offsets to disambiguate equal literals on one line. Earlier reports identify ordered mutations by function, line, before and after.
The same ordered decision samples were compared before and after. Every previously killed mutation was still killed.
Per-mutant durations include concurrent campaign work and are not application or suite benchmarks.
